bangladesh_dmi_regressor.target_definition: Dry-matter intake in kilograms per cow per day

bangladesh_milk_yield_regressor.target_definition: Measured milk yield in litres per cow per day

missing_value_policy: Fail closed when cow ID, a required feature, or the task target is missing. No imputation is performed because the approved source contains no missing values in these fields.
unknown_category_policy: OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore') permits unseen genetic-group and THI labels to transform without crashing; such predictions remain outside validated source support.
known_limitations: DMI offered/refusal measurement protocol is not fully documented.
Numeric temperature, humidity, and THI values are absent.
Five physiology cow identifiers do not match the DMI/milk workbook.
Eight of FarmLite's current nine inputs are absent.
Genetic group maps only partially to FarmLite breed.
Same-day DMI and milk timing is unresolved.
Blood data is not available to ordinary FarmLite users.
Milk-composition outcomes are not prediction-time features.
Results apply to the study population and are not commercially validated.
